text:
In 2011 international (PPP) dollars, U.S. GDP per capita in 1850 was about $2,825, the Maddison Project Database figure for that year. Nominal income of roughly $110 per person in 1850, scaled by the long-run rise in U.S. prices, and a backcast from about $50,000 in 2011 at roughly 1.8% a year over 161 years, both land near $2,800–$3,000. Later Maddison revisions and MeasuringWorth’s GDP deflator can move that point estimate by a few hundred dollars.

CONFIDENCE: 74
